label: prf:wigner-np-pairing
title: Proof of wigner np pairing
html:
Proof. Proof of wigner np pairing

Proof. The partition (2,2) is self-conjugate (\lambda = \lambda'), with q-dimension d_q((2,2)) = [2]_q and Wedderburn weight w_{(2,2)} = [2]_q^2/[4]_q!.

By the branching rule H_4(R, q) \to H_3(R, q), the restriction of V_{(2,2)} contains only V_{(2,1)} (the standard representation) with multiplicity 1. Therefore the (2,2) contribution to binding is carried entirely by the standard channel, consistent with extremal cancellation for pn crossings (confined knot binding).

The scaling \min(Z, N)/A counts the maximum number of proton-neutron T{=}0 pairs per nucleon. Each pair contributes \hat{V}_{\mathrm{pn}} \cdot \alpha of binding through the standard channel.

The Kerov q-hook walk [kerov1996] provides the iterative construction: at each nucleon addition, the pn crossings project onto the (2,2) partition, accumulating the Wigner energy step by step from A = 1. The Féray–Méliot q-Plancherel CLT [feray-meliot2012] gives the asymptotic convergence rate O(1/\sqrt{k}) of the accumulator across Hecke levels. \square
